returnedProposals.new:

returnedProposals.diagnosis: Horizontal displacement adds direction and speed instead of multiplying them. Multiplication preserves zero and negative directions, then clamps the resulting position to the existing bounds.

The first RGB pixel currently reads itself, while the second reads the first. Adding three to the first pixel's channel indices swaps both pixels within each six-channel row, preserving row and channel order.
Addition and subtraction opcodes are reversed. Emit opcode one for the plus token and opcode two for the minus token, preserving the existing postfix operand order.

With downward-positive coordinates, negative positions are airborne. Landing must trigger at or past ground zero so the existing landing branch resets vertical position and velocity while preserving airborne motion.

Each recursion appends one sample but subtracts two from the remaining count. Subtracting one makes decoding append exactly count samples, preserving empty-input termination and exact RLE round trips.
